svg.title: Tram stop lengths & levels
svg.desc: Light-rail example: 45 metre flat platform, two illustrative six metre access ramps, total 57 metres; two 34 by 2.4 metre tram bodies. Separate 30 and 61 metre city-stop comparisons share the same scale. Source claims: tram-length. Example adjacent-level rise 0.30 m at 5% gives two 6 m ramps. Helsinki normally uses 0.27 m; this is a separate context. Nominal tram body plan is 34 × 2.4 m; the 3.4 m body height/detail and base thickness are illustrations. Additional crossing waiting areas and clearances are excluded. City-stop strips are comparisons, not substituted light-rail layouts.
